# Security Policy

Please refer to the complete organizational [Information Security Policy & Governance Charter](../SECURITY.md).

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within Grainwish AI, please report it immediately:

- **Email:** [support@grainwish.com](mailto:support@grainwish.com)
- **Response SLA:** Critical vulnerabilities are acknowledged within 24 hours.
- **Incident Response Process:** Identify ➔ Contain ➔ Investigate ➔ Recover ➔ Notify ➔ Review.

Please do **not** disclose security vulnerabilities publicly until our team has had an opportunity to review and remediate them.
